export function escapeHtml(str) { if (typeof str !== 'string') return ''; return str .replace(/&/g, '&') .replace(//g, '>') .replace(/"/g, '"') .replace(/'/g, '''); } function layout({ title, content, currentUrl }) { return ` ${escapeHtml(title)} - Book Tracker
📚 Reading Log Track what you read
${content}

Simple personal reading tracker. Saved locally.

`; } export function renderHomePage({ readingBooks, finishedBooks, error }) { const errorMessage = error ? `
${escapeHtml(error)}
` : ''; const renderBookItem = (book, isReading) => { const notesPreview = book.notes ? `

${escapeHtml(book.notes.length > 140 ? book.notes.slice(0, 140) + '…' : book.notes)}

` : ''; const actionButton = isReading ? `
` : `
`; return `

  • ${escapeHtml(book.title)}

    ${isReading ? 'Reading' : 'Finished'}
    ${book.author ? `

    by ${escapeHtml(book.author)}

    ` : ''} ${notesPreview}
    View details & notes → ${actionButton}
    • `; }; const readingList = readingBooks.length > 0 ? `
      ${readingBooks.map((b) => renderBookItem(b, true)).join('')}
    ` : `

    You aren't reading any books right now.

    Add one using the form below!
    `; const finishedList = finishedBooks.length > 0 ? `
      ${finishedBooks.map((b) => renderBookItem(b, false)).join('')}
    ` : `

    No finished books yet.

    Mark a book as finished when you complete it!
    `; const content = ` ${errorMessage}

    Currently Reading

    ${readingBooks.length}
    ${readingList}

    Finished

    ${finishedBooks.length}
    ${finishedList}

    Add a Book

    `; return layout({ title: 'My Reading List', content, currentUrl: '/', }); } export function renderBookPage({ book, hostUrl }) { const isReading = book.status === 'reading'; const shareUrl = `${hostUrl}/books/${book.id}`; const content = `
    ← Back to reading list
    ${isReading ? 'Currently Reading' : 'Finished'}

    ${escapeHtml(book.title)}

    ${book.author ? `By ${escapeHtml(book.author)}` : 'Author not specified'}

    ${isReading ? `
    ` : `
    `}

    My Notes

    ${book.notes && book.notes.trim() ? ` 
    ${escapeHtml(book.notes)}
    ` : `

    No notes written for this book yet.

    `}

    Share this book

    Send someone a direct link to this book and your notes:

    Link copied to clipboard!

    `; return layout({ title: book.title, content, currentUrl: `/books/${book.id}`, }); } export function renderNotFoundPage() { const content = `

    Book Not Found

    The book you are looking for does not exist or has been removed.

    Return to Reading List
    `; return layout({ title: 'Book Not Found', content, currentUrl: '', }); }

part.text:
The reading log app has been built and configured.

### What was built
- **Dashboard (`/`)**: Displays two distinct sections for **Currently Reading** and **Finished** books, with item counts and quick-action buttons.
- **Add Book Form**: Easily record a book's title, author, personal notes/quotes, and status.
- **Finish Action**: One-click "Mark Finished ✓" action that updates the book status and moves it to the Finished list.
- **Single Book Page (`/books/:id`)**: Dedicated view displaying the title, author, status, and full formatted notes.
- **Shareable Links**: Direct URLs (`/books/:id`) can be shared with anyone to view a single book without needing an account, along with a "Copy Link" button.
- **JSON File Persistence**: Books are stored in `data/books.json` and persist across restarts.

### How to run
```bash
# Start the server (runs on port 3000 by default)
npm start

# Run automated tests
npm test
```
